dct_title_s: King County, Washington : comprehensive plan land use, 2002
dct_description_sm: Abstract: Comprehensive Plan Land Use with Amendments through September 2002. A comprehensive plan is a generalized; coordinated land use policy statement of the governing body of a county or city that is adopted pursuant to the Growth Management Act.

Purpose: The Comprehensive Plan Land Use Codes in this layer reflect the goals of the King County Comprehensive Plan. These codes are revised annually due to Comprehensive Plan amendments and on an as needed basis due to other planning ordinances. The Comprehensive Plan Land Use categories are officially designated by the King County Comprehensive Plan and required by King County ordinance to be mapped.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational non-commercial use only. This data may not be redistributed by HGL users. King County data are made available with the understanding that they shall be used exclusively by the obtainer or his/her authorized agents.
Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
